title: One fish, two fish, but not the whole sea: Alignment reduces language models’ conceptual diversity

bias_targets.target: Conceptual homogenization / Lack of conceptual diversity
bias_targets.methodology: Measuring the internal versus population-level variability in synthetically-generated LLM populations on word-color association tasks and conceptual similarity judgments, using temperature scaling and demographic persona prompting to test for mode collapse.

primary_bias_target: Conceptual homogenization / Lack of conceptual diversity
